title: Authorize durable business jobs from current owner permissions
goal: Provide the optional auth-owned live authorization port needed by durable Ops FileDist jobs, without persisting sessions or copying system authorization into business code.

in: Optional auth-owned durable job authorization; compat tenant0; fresh owner, role, permission and scope

acceptanceCriteria: Fresh live compat tenant0 grants with nonnil DataScope and registered business action
Owner/role/key/policy revocation and storage/mode uncertainty deny opaquely
Logout and cold restart do not require a stored token
Targeted real MySQL CGO race and independent review
Official publication and downstream consumption remain explicit until performed

executionRoles.implementerPosture: Base Generator owns scoped public auth port and tests.
reviewerPosture: Independent review routed by coordinator before official release

humanGates: Official publication decision and separate final product/production acceptance
